response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional software engineering fundamentals with 17 years of professional experience and strong code quality practices, he is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirements. The position explicitly requires a C++ developer with hands-on expertise in C++, STL, and systems programming. Bogdan has only 6 months of documented C++ professional experience from 2014-2015 at National Instruments, with his career trajectory for the past decade focused entirely on TypeScript/Node.js and DLang development. Critically, C++ is absent from his listed technical skills, and he lacks any background in industrial automation, embedded systems, IoT applications, security standards (IEC 62443), or the specialized networking protocols essential to this role.
strengths: Extensive 17-year software development career with proven ability to architect, design, and lead complex projects across multiple technology domains and platforms
Strong quality mindset and mentoring capability evidenced by test-driven development expertise, code craftsmanship practices, and multiple technical workshops teaching software best practices
Excellent technical communication and documentation skills demonstrated through conference talks, published workshops, and well-maintained open-source projects
concerns: Critical mismatch on primary technical requirement: only 6 months of C++ professional experience from 2014-2015; C++ not listed in current skills despite role title explicitly stating 'C++ Developer'
Zero background in industrial automation, embedded systems, IoT applications, or manufacturing domain; expertise concentrated entirely on web/SaaS platforms and general-purpose software
No demonstrated knowledge of secure development practices (SDL implementation, IEC 62443 standards), industrial cybersecurity, or specialized industrial protocols (MQTT, Modbus TCP/IP, OPC UA)

key_factors.factor: Industrial Automation and Embedded Systems Domain Experience
General Software Architecture and Code Quality Practices
